title: Largest 3-Same-Digit Number in String

Invariant: Check each length-three window; among windows whose digits match, retain the largest digit.
Edge cases: Locally tested against the published example and additional boundary cases.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String largestGoodInteger(String num) { String best=""; for(int i=0;i+2<num.length();i++) if(num.charAt(i)==num.charAt(i+1)&&num.charAt(i)==num.charAt(i+2)&&(best.isEmpty()||num.charAt(i)>best.charAt(0))) best=num.substring(i,i+3); return best; } }
complexity_reason: Check each length-three window; among windows whose digits match, retain the largest digit.

import java.util.*;
class Solution { private int ans; private int[] dfs(TreeNode n){if(n==null)return new int[]{0,0};int[] l=dfs(n.left),r=dfs(n.right);int sum=l[0]+r[0]+n.val,count=l[1]+r[1]+1;if(sum/count==n.val)ans++;return new int[]{sum,count};} public int averageOfSubtree(TreeNode root){ans=0;dfs(root);return ans;} }

Invariant: Sort each word’s characters to create a signature and append only when the signature differs from the previous kept signature.
Edge cases: Locally tested against the published example and additional boundary cases.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public List<String> removeAnagrams(String[] words){List<String> out=new ArrayList<>();String prev=null;for(String w:words){char[] a=w.toCharArray();Arrays.sort(a);String sig=new String(a);if(!sig.equals(prev))out.add(w);prev=sig;}return out;} }
complexity_reason: Sort each word’s characters to create a signature and append only when the signature differs from the previous kept signature.

Invariant: Count each character in s and target; take the minimum available-to-required frequency ratio over target characters.
Edge cases: Locally tested against the published example and additional boundary cases.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int rearrangeCharacters(String s,String target){int[] h=new int[26],n=new int[26];for(char c:s.toCharArray())h[c-'a']++;for(char c:target.toCharArray())n[c-'a']++;int ans=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int i=0;i<26;i++)if(n[i]>0)ans=Math.min(ans,h[i]/n[i]);return ans;} }
complexity_reason: Count each character in s and target; take the minimum available-to-required frequency ratio over target characters.

title: Apply Discount to Prices
notes:
Task: Solve Apply Discount to Prices.
Idea: Apply the percentage discount to valid price tokens and format them to two decimal places.
Invariant: Split on spaces; a token is a price only if it starts with $ and the remaining characters are digits.
Edge cases: Locally tested against the published example and additional boundary cases.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String discountPrices(String sentence,int discount){String[] a=sentence.split(" ",-1);for(int i=0;i<a.length;i++){String t=a[i];if(t.length()>1&&t.charAt(0)=='$'){boolean ok=true;for(int j=1;j<t.length();j++)if(!Character.isDigit(t.charAt(j))){ok=false;break;}if(ok)a[i]=String.format(Locale.US,"$%.2f",Long.parseLong(t.substring(1))*(100-discount)/100.0);}}return String.join(" ",a);} }
complexity_reason: Split on spaces; a token is a price only if it starts with $ and the remaining characters are digits.

title: Min Max Game
notes:
Task: Solve Min Max Game.
Idea: Repeatedly replace each adjacent pair with min, max, min, max until one value remains.
Invariant: At each round, halve the array and apply min to even-indexed pairs and max to odd-indexed pairs.
Edge cases: Locally tested against the published example and additional boundary cases.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public int minMaxGame(int[] nums){int n=nums.length;while(n>1){for(int i=0;i<n/2;i++)nums[i]=i%2==0?Math.min(nums[2*i],nums[2*i+1]):Math.max(nums[2*i],nums[2*i+1]);n/=2;}return nums[0];} }
space_complexity: O(n) Python copy; O(1) Java extra space
complexity_reason: At each round, halve the array and apply min to even-indexed pairs and max to odd-indexed pairs.

title: Calculate Amount Paid in Taxes
notes:
Task: Solve Calculate Amount Paid in Taxes.
Idea: Calculate the total tax paid on income using progressive tax brackets.
Invariant: For each bracket, tax only the income portion above the previous upper bound and up to the current bound.
Edge cases: Locally tested against the published example and additional boundary cases.
code:
import java.util.*;
class Solution { public double calculateTax(int[][] brackets,int income){double tax=0;int prev=0;for(int[] b:brackets){int taxable=Math.min(income,b[0])-prev;if(taxable>0)tax+=taxable*b[1]/100.0;prev=b[0];if(income<=b[0])break;}return tax;} }
complexity_reason: For each bracket, tax only the income portion above the previous upper bound and up to the current bound.

import java.util.*;
class Solution { public String greatestLetter(String s){boolean[] seen=new boolean[128];for(char c:s.toCharArray())seen[c]=true;for(char c='Z';c>='A';c--)if(seen[c]&&seen[c-'A'+'a'])return String.valueOf(c);return "";} }
